note: Text budgets per box variant, px of drawn text from the pen origin on one line, measured in-game from the marker/ruler build (docs/re/width.md). `measured` means the recorded shot demonstrates either the clip limit or an explicitly documented conservative lower bound; false means inferred geometry requiring measurement.
